Never states that the rule is what made a wrong test cost money; quoting 'the hinge of the whole matter' is not the statement
No Effie Loomis, no Wilbur Teague; only Sill, named in passing as a source. Officer roster not recovered
Selby Vose absent from Section A entirely; the B3/B4 mention cannot travel into A (and dates him 1911, not 1913)
Station-gain line appears only at C1(a); no credit travels from Section C into Section A
Ostrey Hollow station, opened 4 May 1896, opened with borrowed glassware (Sill's outfit). Core fact of a >2-bold item
No description in Section A of weighing, composite sample, percent on the bottle neck, or cream out/skim back
Ammon & Sons, April 1897 invoice, in use from 1 May 1897; Tarnet and the 14th missing but core fact carried

Flatness of the 0.19 across every month and all 26 years stated only at C1(b), not in Section A
No statement that a pipette cannot be checked without a burette
Ansel Keddie tester at Ostrey Hollow, 29 unbroken seasons from 1896 to 1925
Test book named in Section A (Story 3). Earned on the key's bold-gating mechanic only; the bench routine and the book's form are not described
Summary leaf absent; 3.80 and 3.61 appear only in Section C. Story 3 says the tests 'rose markedly' with no figures
8 May, nine weeks to 10 July, borrowed measure, return on the day the station's glass came back, Keddie's question mark. Missing only the 3.80 level
Section A has Orra Keddie as the tester's wife and 'the Brants' as her family, but never that she was Emmet Brant's sister; that claim sits in B2
1919 circular not in Section A ('it stayed closed for eleven years' only); no 17 March 1925 statement
Keddie's death in 1934 never mentioned
Granddaughter, correct; great-niece resolved by the narrator's own dated closing correction
No derivation: run explicitly says the sources never name which of Ansel's children is Ivy's parent, so the Ivy-Duncan-Ansel chain is not given
Second cousins with the full derivation: Emmet and Orra siblings, Roy and Duncan first cousins, Hazel and Ivy their children
